(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((bg (mode-list (apply append g)))
                (objs (sort-by (filter (lambda (o) (!= (obj-color o) bg))
                                       (objects g bg))
                               (lambda (o) (obj-size o))))
                (n (length objs))
                (matches (filter (lambda (x) x)
                                 (map (lambda (nf)
                                        (let* ((ft (for/sum ((i (range 0 nf)))
                                                     (obj-size (nth objs i))))
                                               (found (find (lambda (cand)
                                                              (= (- (* (obj-h cand)
                                                                       (obj-w cand))
                                                                    (obj-size cand))
                                                                 ft))
                                                            (map (lambda (i)
                                                                   (nth objs i))
                                                                 (range nf n)))))
                                          (and found (list nf found))))
                                      (range (- n 1) 0 -1)))))
           (if (null? matches)
               g
               (let* ((best (first matches))
                      (nf (first best))
                      (tmpl (second best))
                      (br1 (obj-r1 tmpl))
                      (bc1 (obj-c1 tmpl))
                      (br2 (obj-r2 tmpl))
                      (bc2 (obj-c2 tmpl))
                      (oh (+ 1 (- br2 br1)))
                      (ow (+ 1 (- bc2 bc1)))
                      (fillers (reverse (map (lambda (i) (nth objs i)) (range 0 nf))))
                      (tc (obj-color tmpl))
                      (tcells (map (lambda (cell)
                                     (list (- (first cell) br1) (- (second cell) bc1)))
                                   (obj-cells tmpl))))
                 (reduce (lambda (acc f)
                           (let* ((fc (obj-color f))
                                  (fh (obj-h f))
                                  (fw (obj-w f))
                                  (placed (find (lambda (pos)
                                                  (let* ((pr (first pos))
                                                         (pc (second pos)))
                                                    (and
                                                      (<= (+ pr fh) oh)
                                                      (<= (+ pc fw) ow)
                                                      (all? (lambda (dr)
                                                              (all? (lambda (dc)
                                                                      (let* ((tr (+ pr
                                                                                    dr))
                                                                             (tcc (+ pc
                                                                                     dc)))
                                                                        (and
                                                                          (not (for/or ((p tcells))
                                                                                       (and
                                                                                         (= (first p)
                                                                                            tr)
                                                                                         (= (second p)
                                                                                            tcc))))
                                                                          (zero? (at acc
                                                                                     tr
                                                                                     tcc)))))
                                                                    (range 0 fw)))
                                                            (range 0 fh)))))
                                                (positions-in-rect 0
                                                                   0
                                                                   (- oh 1)
                                                                   (- ow 1)))))
                             (if placed
                                 (reduce (lambda (gg dr)
                                           (reduce (lambda (gg2 dc)
                                                     (set-cell gg2
                                                               (+ (first placed) dr)
                                                               (+ (second placed) dc)
                                                               fc))
                                                   gg
                                                   (range 0 fw)))
                                         acc
                                         (range 0 fh))
                                 acc)))
                         (build-grid oh
                                     ow
                                     (r c)
                                     (if (for/or ((p tcells))
                                                 (and (= (first p) r) (= (second p) c)))
                                         tc
                                         0))
                         fillers))))))
